decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building. The rear and flank walls of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall be finished in brickwork to match the ground floor of the house.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans P/HN/14.4/1.2 submitted 21September 2011, P/HN/14.4/3 Received 05th September 2011 and Design and Access Statement submitted 27th May 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The window formed in the side elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional window, door or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the extension and outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The detached outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family house known as 14 St Paul's Church and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and shall not include kitchen or bathroom facilities).
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and a double storey flank extension and erection of an outbuilding in the rear garden
